provisional_referrals.reason: Main and evidence should retain the useful precise retrospective motto chronology and later state adoption without claiming fraternity had no earlier political uses.
Main meaning must express the source-backed reasons for rural resistance and bourgeois accommodation, not leave them as generic attitudes.
Preserve substantive institutions/franchise and the self-perpetuation/second-coup transition, not merely the democratic label.
Commons redistribution was permitted; feudal abolition was without compensation; concessions sought support while containing radical allies.
Italian national consciousness was encouraged by proof that old territorial barriers could be swept away, while foreign rule compromised its Jacobin beneficiaries.
Belgium and Venetian compensation were concrete; the Rhine frontier remained ambiguous, contradicting Directory bargaining intentions despite relatively moderate preliminary terms.
Named access must retrieve the isolated garrison and its costly capitulation, not merely a general crisis.
The retained incidental language example is explicit in the parent and must remain inside its treatment/facet page scope.
Anti-French peasant protest using Jacobin martyrs is a distinct counterexample to equating resistance with traditionalist ideology.
Tourcoing’s numerical and defensive result is distinct from the decisive turning point later assigned to Fleurus.
Sectional opposition and absent Montagnards threatened voting dominance and helped prompt acceptance of a purge.
Quimper demanded suppression of the central Tribunal; Toulon created a local tribunal. Preserve the comparison without conflating actors.
Rival governments seldom equated recruitment resistance with treason; the lower scale of opposition excludes Ireland1798.
The rejection of Barruel rests on distinguishing membership/vocabulary overlap from an organized conspiracy, not simply labelling the thesis false.
Couthon’s attempted restraint explicitly drew on Caen; preserve that comparison while distinguishing his actions from his successors.
Retain actual institutional and Church changes alongside the democratic-liberty objection, rather than generic rationalization.
The parent retains immunity but its278 evidence currently describes a different episode; preserve both distinct claims.
The Convention’s majority support for both guard protection and indivisibility is the concrete source demonstration of shared unity claims.
Bonaparte sought government as the nation’s representative and operative power, not merely an abstract stronger executive.
